identity.name: Adeeb Noor
identity.title: Professor of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence

summary: Strategic executive leader, professor, researcher and builder with 17+ years of experience across Saudi government, higher education and healthcare. Work spans sovereign and responsible AI strategy, data-driven workforce planning, research-and-innovation governance, hospital digital modernization, biomedical informatics, venture building and institutional transformation. The recurring pattern is to translate evidence into operating models, platforms, policies and products that can function at national or institutional scale.
metrics: Research translated into systems and ventures

experience.title: Chief Strategy Advisor — Office of the VP for Research & Innovation
experience.org: King Abdulaziz University, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
bullets: Led enterprise-wide restructuring of research and graduate studies toward stronger governance, private-sector integration and financial sustainability.
Designed a Tri-Party Partnership System (university × industry × government) and framed the investment thesis and operating model for KAU’s R&D and innovation roadmap with AT Kearney.
Secured 6 international MOUs, SAR 500K in commercial contracts and SAR 1M in inbound research funding within 12 months; facilitated 3 joint ventures.
Conceived a Living Lab commercial P&L model, formalized an Industry Liaison Office and advanced an output-based academic supervision model focused on research impact and graduate completion.

experience.title: Founder & Lead Architect — IMAM GenAI Ecosystem
bullets: Built a Saudi-made GenAI learning ecosystem designed around local identity, labor-market relevance and AI-native curriculum design.
Latest executive CV reports a pilot of n=68 with 70% job placement and +35% salary uplift; commercialization and institutional partnerships are under development.

experience.title: Full Professor — Faculty of Computing & Information Technology
experience.org: King Abdulaziz University, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
bullets: Leads research and teaching across AI, data science, biomedical informatics, digital health, software engineering and education innovation.
Develops research programs spanning allocation identity (RIDI), drug-interaction knowledge, neuro-symbolic AI, health prediction and AI-enabled curriculum systems.

experience.title: Senior Executive Advisor — National Human Capability Development
experience.org: Ministry of Education, Office of the Minister, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
bullets: Designed and oversaw national human-capital development for 540,000+ educators across 49 districts.
Authored and presented “Educating the Kingdom: Insights for the Future” (MoEinsights2023) and contributed to a 10-year national education roadmap.

Established a national educator career pathway and delivered SAR 11.25M in year-one savings through ML-driven redundancy analysis.
Co-authored education privatization strategy and architected Kitabati, an e-textbook privatization model that received ministerial/deputy approval for pilot.

experience.title: Executive Director of Advisory & AI Strategy / Head of Advisory Service

Positioned Arabic and Islamic data assets as a strategic moat for ethical AI and designed an IP-licensing model aimed at reducing dependency on government funding.

Guided enterprise AI strategy and predictive analytics for workforce planning and resource allocation.
